newsitem.title: USA: Apple says it updates retail plan.
newsitem.headline: Apple says it updates retail plan.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Friday that it has set out a four-point plan to simplify its U.S. sales channel structure and improve the visibility of Apple products in stores and with resellers.

The four objectives of Apple's U.S. channel changes are to support resellers that carry mostly Apple products, make the sales channel more flexible, focus on specific markets and continue to simplify its product line.

"Our current structure does not reward those in the channel who are strong advocates of Apple products nor does it encourage them to focus on the markets where Apple has a strong franchise and industry-leading solutions," said Robin Abrams, vice president and general manager, Apple Americas. "We intend to change that with these programs."
"As we regain and re-establish our financial position and technological leadership we want that new momentum to flow through our channels to the purchaser of an Apple product," Abrams said.
